Edition match: The photographed box has the original Z-Man and Lookout logos and no later Animeeples banner. The publisher-authored 2008 English original rulebook cited by this record (https://cdn.1j1ju.com/medias/dd/16/f5-agricola-rulebook.pdf) confirms the Z-Man/Lookout release.. Original image URL: https://i.ebayimg.com/images/g/6WsAAOSwdv5lT6z4/s-l1200.png. Processing note: Cropped the physical box from a tabletop photograph and reduced it to a 440-pixel JPEG.

firstPlayerRule: Players choose the starting player, who takes the starting player marker and two food. The other players each receive three food.
clarifications: During the work phase, players place family members one at a time clockwise from the marker holder. The marker does not rotate automatically; the Starting Player action changes it.
